A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AttriBoT work. Their complete main text, references, Tables 1–2, Figures 1–11, equations, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison despite different formatting and pagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original attribution accuracy and computational efficiency experiments on SQuAD 2.0, HotpotQA, and QASPER, including approximation validation and additional analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix C, including comparisons across models and agreement with human annotations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.5 retain the same KV caching, hierarchical attribution, proxy modeling, proxy pruning, and compositions. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same open-book question-answering coverage on SQuAD 2.0, HotpotQA, and QASPER. No additional dataset, domain, or test scenario appears in the appendices.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain attention weights, gradient norm, sentence embedding similarity, and ContextCite, alongside exact LOO. Comparator membership is unchanged in both the main and appendix figures.

E3.justification: Model configurations, preprocessing, prompting, attribution granularity, mAP, and efficiency metrics are unchanged. Appendix B and Table 2 retain 1,000 examples each for SQuAD 2.0 and HotpotQA and 998 for QASPER.

E4.justification: Both retain the approximation checks in Figure 1, component trade-offs in Figures 3–5, mismatched-proxy analyses in Figures 7–10, and human-annotation analysis in Figure 11. Their questions and evidence are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Appendix B.2 retains the ESD procedure with significance level 0.05 and maximum 50 outliers; neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, or performance uncertainty intervals.

E6.justification: Figures 1–11 retain identical plotted results, and Table 2 retains identical numerical entries. Reported findings also match, including approximately 1.6× practical speedup from KV caching and 300× speedup with a reported 10% mAP drop in the human-annotation comparison.

T1.justification: The attribution definitions, Equation 1, theoretical FLOPs in Table 1, derivations and assumptions in Appendix A, and statistical formulas in Appendix B.2 are unchanged apart from typesetting.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: composable approximations, Pareto-optimal efficiency–faithfulness trade-offs, greater than 300× speedup, and attribution approximately 30× faster than response generation.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of approximation fidelity, numerical error, mismatched proxies, and human-annotation agreement. Appendix D preserves the same duplicate-context limitation and preprocessing recommendations.

D1.justification: Hardware specifications, model identifiers, preprocessing instructions, prompt templates, baseline details, practitioner recommendations, and the implementation link are retained. Appendix D is existing guidance, not newly added documentation.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same relationships to citation generation, feature attribution, and training-data attribution; bibliography differences are formatting only.

P1.justification: v3 revises the author affiliation/contact block and work-location footnote, adds conference-header text, and makes small wording and citation-presentation edits. Section order and substantive prose remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The entire document is retypeset in ICLR format, changing fonts, margins, heading styles, running headers, figure sizes, table styling, and prompt highlighting. Float placement changes substantially, including grouping Figures 3–5 together and placing all appendix figures before Appendix D; the same figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 substantially changes presentation but retains the same scientific argument, empirical evidence, derivations, limitations, and reproducibility information. The minor editorial edits and conference reformatting do not establish a meaningful net improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
